_comment: Block definitions. Ids are stable forever (saves depend on them); append, never renumber. Colours are linear RGB 0..1: color is every face, unless the block gives top, side or bottom a colour of its own (grass, dry grass and snow sit on dirt, so their undersides and the grasses' sides are dirt). Andrew tunes them live in the look panel (F1), which saves them back here (rock palette from the feature inventory: the old viewer's bed tints at full strength on stone). Flags: solid (occupies space, occludes), liquid (water-level byte layer applies), gravity (falls when the cell below is replaceable; the simulation rule, nothing by name), replaceable (a falling block may land in or pass through it). Textures (M3b): texture is a PNG in textures/ beside this file for every face, top_texture, side_texture and bottom_texture one face each; a face without one shows its colour. texture_size is the size every picture is drawn at (Andrew's setting: 16, or 32). hidden keeps a block off the hotbar list (blocks are never deleted); was lists a block's former names, so saves that know it by one still load; hotbar is what keys 1-9 hold (the look panel writes it).

blocks.name: deep_ocean
blocks._comment: Generator only, coarsest LOD: opaque sea where nothing lies under the water voxel. Colour = water at alpha 0.62 over mean strata rock (the next finer LOD's ocean seen from above).
